reuse.why: Linking goes through the existing linkBankSyncAccount, and the Akahu download is generalised into downloadServerTransactions shared by Akahu and Fintegra; only the extra accounts-listing handler is written by copying.

duplication.why: fintegraAccounts is a near-verbatim copy of akahuAccounts/pluggyAiAccounts with only the server URL changed; everything else is shared or parameterised.

placement.why: Link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in accounts/sync.ts, base path in server-config.ts and the account type in types/models, exactly where the other providers live.

scope.why: Adds an unrequested 'fintegra-accounts' listing request and touches desktop-client files although the request is server-side only (some of these follow from extending SYNC_PROVIDERS).

maintainability.why: Fintegra plugs into the existing provider seams cleanly and the download helper reduces per-provider code; the copied listing handler and the extra akahu||fintegra branch in processBankSyncDownload add small per-provider growth.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Linking uses linkBankSyncAccount and syncing uses the shared download and processBankSyncDownload paths.

disguised_duplication.where: fintegraAccounts copies akahuAccounts openly, without reshaping.
